jobs.description:
What is a Business Analyst in insurance domain at cream?

As Stella, Business Analyst (in Insurance Domain), embrace your role and support the different applications in the insurance industry (life and non life). You will be the liaison among business and IT teams.
Your tasks

• Participate and lead requirements gathering sessions with clients

• Produce Functional Design and Requirements Specification documents on domains of expertise e.g. New Business, Claims, etc.

• Implement, in means of configuration, relevant aspects of the client's requirements

• Write/ Review test plans

• Perform expert testing and defect management following development/configuration

• Conduct training sessions on the system and its configured product set

• Production support including UAT testing, defect analysis and Change Requests management

• Perform gap analysis

• You have a Master degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience: ideally 3 or more years of experience within an insurance company

• You have proven experience as a Business Analyst

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer-oriented and you have high communications skills and analytical skills

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and a good command of English, Dutch is a plus

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

 
• 
You have experience as a Operator.

 
• 
You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
You can speak English. This is a requirement for the position.

 
• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

As a machine operator in our modern citrus department, you play a crucial role in operating and optimizing automated production and packaging lines. You use MES software to monitor and improve the performance of machines and production lines. Together with your team, you ensure a smooth workflow and high-quality end products.

Your day consists of setting up, adjusting, and operating machines, timely providing materials, and guiding colleagues on the line. You work closely with the technical department in case of malfunctions and regularly perform minor maintenance tasks. Additionally, you register production data and help maintain order and cleanliness in the workplace.

Are you a team player who likes to take initiative and think about improvements? Do you want to work in a growing department within a stable company? Apply now and discover your opportunities as a machine operator in our citrus department!

• At least lower secondary education
• Experience as an operator is required (0-1 year welcome)
• Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (sometimes three shifts) and weekends
• Team-oriented and communicative
• Accurate and safety-conscious
• Proactive and solution-oriented

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.
For this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

Responsibilities

• Act as the primary business lead and Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for assigned feature areas within the transformation program.
• Drive business engagement across local, regional, and external stakeholder groups throughout the project lifecycle.
• Coordinate business activities during the design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare phases.
• Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, producing deliverables such as BRDs, user stories, and process flows.
• Review solution proposals from a business perspective and challenge designs to ensure they meet operational needs.
• Define business acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure successful process validation.
• Assess operational impacts and identify requirements for training, communication, and change readiness to support solution adoption.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or Product Analyst.
• Experience working within large-scale ERP, digital, or business transformation programs.
• Proven expertise in documenting business requirements using BRDs, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
• Strong background in stakeholder management and facilitating complex workshop facilitation sessions.
• Experience with governance support, including tracking decisions, risks, and dependencies for steering committees.
• Ability to translate complex business needs into actionable delivery requirements and technical specifications.
• Proactive and self-managing with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with a delivery-focused mindset.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience within the retail industry.
• Knowledge of POS systems, merchandising, pricing, or supply chain.
• Experience with SAP or other major retail platforms and omnichannel commerce solutions.
• Knowledge of data and reporting solutions and master data management.

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.  Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
• Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
• Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends
Profile

• MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
• Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
• Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
• Good communication skills in English
• A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
• Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation
Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

 Employment Conditions

• Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
• Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
• Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
• The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
• Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
• Vacancy number: 27390
Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

As a Truck Adaptation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing technical solutions for customers requiring specific modifications to their vehicles.

• Translate customer requirements into technically feasible concepts.
• Design and document non-standard solutions to ensure successful assembly within the production facility.
• Advise internal stakeholders on technical possibilities and solutions.
• Collaborate closely with various departments across the organization.
• Take ownership of technical decisions and assume end responsibility for your engineering concepts.
• Contribute to innovative and sustainable transport solutions.

For our client, Volvo Trucks Ghent, the largest truck manufacturing plant within the Volvo Group, we are looking for a Truck Adaptation Engineer. From its Ghent site, nearly 3,000 employees work every day to produce high-quality trucks. Innovation, sustainability, quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of this international manufacturing environment. You will join a team of engineers responsible for developing customer-specific truck adaptations and delivering tailored technical solutions.

 

As a Truck Adaptation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing technical solutions for customers requiring specific modifications to their vehicles.

• Translate customer requirements into technically feasible concepts.
• Design and document non-standard solutions to ensure successful assembly within the production facility.
• Advise internal stakeholders on technical possibilities and solutions.
• Collaborate closely with various departments across the organization.
• Take ownership of technical decisions and assume end responsibility for your engineering concepts.
• Contribute to innovative and sustainable transport solutions.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent through experience.
• A strong interest in automotive engineering and vehicle technology.
• Previous experience is not required; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
• Knowledge of trucks is considered a strong asset.
• Accurate, structured and capable of working independently.
• A strong team player with excellent collaboration skills.
• Good knowledge of MS Office.
• Able to read and interpret technical drawings.
• Excellent command of Dutch and English.

Team/division description
 

Material Engineering division widely contributes to Toyota development activities from vehicle development projects to fundamental research. Our team is committed to develop solutions and to introduce attractive & environment-friendly materials towards circular economy, carbon neutrality and customer happiness.
 

Your responsibilities
 

 
• Prepare Purchase Orders, and proceed receiving and invoicing 
 
• Process technical reports towards official issuance acc. to our internal process 
 
• Prepare and format documents, reports, presentations
 
• Establish guidelines and procedures 
 
• Actively propose and implement cost reduction and efficiency ideas 
 
• Support the team’s digitalization processes 
 
• Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments. 
 
• Support internal and external communication with stakeholders. 
 
• Assist in organizing events, workshops, and team activities.  

Your profile
 

 
• Proven experience as administrative assistant 
 
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
 
• Rigorous and self-disciplined
 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Flemish and French are a plus.
 
• A very good knowledge of Excel is required (advanced formulas, pivot table...), and powerBI. A good command of powerApp is a plus.
 
• Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information.
 
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 
• You have a Toyota DNA, this means: 
 

Courage: you are ready to let go of the easy path to reach challenging targets Collaboration: you are a team player, respectful and inclusive in your style and you take a customer-oriented approach
 

Creativity: your passion drives you to explore innovative ideas and challenge the impossible
 

Curiosity: you combine imagination and fact-based observation
 

Coaching: you share knowledge and feedback with your colleagues and celebrate each other’s success

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Product Owner
jobs.description:
As Louis, Product Owner, embrace your role and be part of an Agile team from one of our clients. You will be responsible for the successful outcome of the client project by following an Agile methodology. Your goal is to maximize the value of the product/project.
Your tasks 

• Manage and plan the Sprint in collaboration with the Scrum Master

• Manage and define the Product Backlog and prioritize the different elements and goals

• Make sure that the Product Backlog is visible and comprehensive for everyone

• Coordinate the team and maintain in order the backlog

• Write the user stories

• Optimize the work of the team

• Challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do WE expect from our Consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner

• You have a good knowledge of the Agile methodologies

• You have good organizational and communicational skills

• You are fluent in French or Dutch (Bonus: with good knowledge of the other one) and English

-

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A high-quality food company that delivers fresh products daily to hospitality clients and large-scale kitchens. The 300 employees work together day after day to make this possible. This market leader not only takes care of its customers, but also of its employees. Quality always comes first, which is why regular training is provided.

What does your working day look like as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Restocking the frozen storage areas: you place incoming goods in the correct locations according to the warehouse layout

 
• 
You work with a handheld scanner that registers all movements

 
• 
You pick the correct goods and prepare them for transport, based on customer orders

 
• 
You perform accurate picking tasks by selecting the right products and efficiently preparing them for shipment

 
• 
You work according to a fixed schedule: Monday to Thursday from 12:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and Sunday from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. This gives you a fixed schedule every week

Who are we looking for as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Physically fit: you can comfortably lift boxes weighing up to 20 kg

 
• 
You are comfortable working in a frozen environment and can work effectively in temperatures as low as -25°C while wearing appropriate protective clothing

 
• 
Experience in logistics or as a warehouse worker is a plus

 
• 
You pay close attention to quality

 
• 
You communicate good in Dutch or English to correctly follow up on order forms

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

About the Role
 

We are looking for a versatile and reliable Administrative & Finance Support Officer to join our Finance & Administration team.
 

This is not a role for an accounting specialist, nor are we searching for the next CFO of the group. Instead, we are looking for a well-organized administrative professional who is comfortable with numbers, has a practical mindset, and enjoys bringing structure and order to daily operations.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Processing and monitoring bank statements 
 
• Managing and reviewing expense reports 
 
• Verifying and following up on supplier invoices 
 
• Updating Excel files and internal databases 
 
• Document management and filing 
 
• Providing general administrative support to the Finance & Administration department 
 
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• Previous experience in an administrative, back-office, or financial support role 
 
• Experience working with an ERP system or integrated business software is a strong asset 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams 
 
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills 
 
• Reliable and trustworthy professional attitude 
 
• Ability to work independently 
 
• Practical mindset and willingness to build a long-term career within the company 
 

We also appreciate people who ask questions when they don't know something rather than allowing the problem to mature quietly in their inbox.
 

 
 

Language Skills
 
 
 
• Good professional command of French and/or Dutch 
 
• Practical knowledge of English, allowing you to communicate by email, phone, and Microsoft Teams in a professional environment 
 
• Willingness to further develop your English skills as part of the role 
 

Being trilingual is certainly an advantage, but we are not necessarily looking for a simultaneous interpreter for the European Commission.
